parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=6 and ASPECT_RATIO=64 achieved val_bpb 1.006925. This is a significant improvement over my previous best (1.011215). Since increasing capacity via depth and width is working, I'll now investigate if a more aggressive learning rate or different warmup can further optimize this larger configuration.
parsed.description: Testing the combination of higher MATRIX_LR (0.08) and WARMUP_RATIO (0.05) on the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64) to see if the larger model can handle higher rates with proper warmup.
